Hi Priya — attaching the two-page addendum and evidence links per your request. Key excerpts below for quick review.

- EU AI Act classification statement (summary):
  * Use case description: automated pre-triage and routing of inbound clinical requests to human agents; outputs are advisory and require clinician confirmation.
  * Risk assessment: based on the Act's annex, this use is potentially high-risk if the system is used to make or significantly influence clinical decisions. Redwood's position: we provide technical controls and operational safeguards to support regulated deployment; final determination rests with Cardinal's product owner and compliance team.
  * Mitigations included: explicit human-in-loop gating, per-request provenance headers, configurable confidence thresholds, granular audit logging (time, model version, input hash), and mandatory canary windows for updates to models that impact routing logic.

- Eval & regression approach (summary):
  * Pre-deployment: offline evaluation against a curated test set (labelled by domain SMEs), slice analysis for demographic and edge-case behaviour, threshold gates for precision/recall based on Cardinal's acceptance criteria.
  * Continuous monitoring: streaming metrics (latency, top-k token divergence, confidence drift), periodic holdout re-evals, and synthetic prompt suites to detect semantic regressions.
  * Rollout & rollback: staged canaries (1%, 5%, 25%) with automated rollback triggers — if at-canary monitored KPIs breach configured thresholds (e.g., >5% drop in top-line accuracy or >10% increase in safety filter hits) we auto-roll back and notify incident channels.
  * Regression harness: reproducible test harness with replayable request traces, seed control for nondeterministic sampling, and post-release regression reports stored in the eval-suite-summary.xlsx artifact.

Next steps: If this looks good, Monica — please attach the evidence pack (RID_Appendix_C_Security_Evidence.pdf, NIST_mapping_table.csv, eval-suite-summary.xlsx) and send to Priya with a Drive link. Priya — happy to schedule a 30-minute technical readout next week if procurement wants a walk-through.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Product Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
